title: The docs say one thing, the chain shows another

scenes.narration: Lanternfish Lend is a lending market that accepts tokenized stocks as collateral.
Its documentation describes an admin key as a co-signer. Quote: it cannot act on its own.
RWA Sonar reads the market's transactions on Solana. That same key signs refinances alone. There is no second signature.
The site shows both on one card: the quote from the docs, the transactions, and the date they were observed.
Why it matters: if John posts collateral there, one key can refinance loans by itself.
John adds the market to his watch list. If the docs or the key change, it shows up in his daily Telegram digest.
What they say, and what the chain shows, side by side at RWA Sonar dot com.
